title: Discovery & research
body: Understand audience, brand, business objective, references and delivery requirements.

title: Concept & script
body: Develop the narrative, creative hook, voiceover and visual beats.

title: Storyboard & visual direction
body: Plan shots, establish reference imagery, define style and continuity.

title: Generative production
body: Create and refine keyframes, characters, environments and motion; select assets that serve the story.

title: Editing & post-production
body: Assemble the narrative, refine pacing, integrate sound, motion graphics, captions and finishing.

title: Review & quality control
body: Check continuity, visual artefacts, audio, brand accuracy and legibility; incorporate agreed feedback.

title: Delivery
body: Export to required formats, aspect ratios and specifications, with relevant assets and handover notes as agreed.
